authoring_rationale: Class B. Nine-property equivalence check: authority same (the group steward decides); decision status same (decided, and settled or staying for the rest of the season); attribution same (the decision is the group steward's in both); persistence same (the new time starts next week and holds for the rest of the season); permission same (the Saturday drop-in is open as the alternative); provenance, memory treatment, boundary crossing and review state not engaged. Surface varied materially: a curt, confident notice against an apologetic, polite message carrying a hedged opinion that the evening slot will probably suit most people better. The hedge concerns suitability only and does not touch the decision; apology and politeness neither reopen nor soften it. Checked that an equivalence finding is reachable from the visible text alone. Authored fresh from the public ADR-0054 and ADR-0055 law only; not adapted from or templated on any other case or corpus; no void-attempt material used. Orientation and identity computed mechanically from the final bytes (ADR-0055 decisions 7, 8 and 11); no wording was adjusted for orientation, identity or position.
